installed_force_torque_sensor.identity_evidence: operator-confirmed body label, historical 2026-07-18 EtherCAT capture, and 2026-07-21 direct USB udev enumeration

measurement_origin_frame_definition.origin: center of the SensONE Gen A tool-side mounting plane
measurement_origin_frame_definition.z_axis: Bota +Z* points from the robot-side mounting plane toward the tool-side mounting plane
measurement_origin_frame_definition.side_center_hole_semantics: IMU location; not the F/T wrench origin

frame_convention.pink_tool_cad_mating_plane: z=0 in the delivered current pink one-piece tool CAD
frame_convention.blue_reference_connector: physically distinct reference connector; it is not the pink CAD mating plane
frame_convention.mechanical_alignment_instruction: Teach the installed flange so its +45 deg B/C tangent-datum normal is parallel to fixture +X; the selected peg flat then becomes fixture +X modulo 60 deg while socket yaw remains zero.
frame_convention.runtime_frame_rule: Mechanical peg clocking is not a sensor/robot/fixture yaw calibration. Transform wrench channels, probe phase, direction posterior, and XY commands through one measured canonical-to-world rotation before learned deployment.

ordered_rigid_chain: Bota SensONE Gen A robot-side mounting plane
Bota SensONE Gen A tool-side mounting plane / wrench origin
current pink tool CAD mating plane
pink one-piece flange and peg tip
unresolved_subtransforms: KUKA media flange to Bota robot-side plane, including the white/silver adapter
Bota tool-side wrench plane to pink CAD mating plane, including the cement-gray adapter

provisional_whole_stack_observation.interpretation: single end-to-end commissioning observation; it includes the white/silver adapter, Bota body, and cement-gray adapter and must not be reconstructed by adding their partial dimensions

pose_dependent_scene_observation.status: operator approximate at the photographed pose
pose_dependent_scene_observation.use: scene-height trace only; not a rigid TCP term and not evidence of cement-gray adapter thickness

folded_start_scene_observation.use: pose-bound scene-height trace only; not a rigid TCP term, not flange thickness, and not a WORLD-Z calibration

known_rigid_geometry.blue_reference_connector_status: operator ruler observation only; separate from the pink tool and excluded from the active pink TCP dimension equation

tool_architecture.construction: one-piece printed current pink flange, short rigid root, and size-specific hex peg
tool_architecture.swap_method: manually unbolt and replace the complete flange-tool
tool_architecture.pose_datum: the current pink-tool CAD mating face and mounting-hole pattern; no blue-part dimension defines this datum
tool_architecture.claim_boundary: The integrated load path removes quick-change fit and clip uncertainty, and the CAD now provides a visible peg-to-flange yaw datum. Printed stiffness, mass properties, mounting repeatability, the as-built peg/socket relative yaw, and the sensor-to-tip transform still require measurement.

sensor_metrology_required.measurement_method: hand-eye/frame calibration plus rigid tool touch-off

simulation_exact.claim_boundary: strict research control copied from the frozen MuJoCo source geometry

hardware_easy_v2.claim_boundary: intentional physical engineering bias; larger straight-wall clearance and entry funnel require a geometry-matched MuJoCo profile, yaw/contact-onset retuning, and terminal-gate retuning

exterior_vertical_ribs.claim_boundary: The existing screw_head_side_visual is collision-disabled; enabling exterior-side collision requires a new validation run.

tool_clocking_commissioning.flange_tangent_datum_to_fixture_x_yaw_se: Signed residual angle after teaching; target zero, not the fixture-to-robot world yaw.
tool_clocking_commissioning.tip_axis_runout_definition: Maximum radial eccentricity of the tip center from the fitted flange datum axis. If measured as peak-to-peak dial TIR, use half the TIR here.
tool_clocking_commissioning.tip_height_definition: Perpendicular distance from the pink-CAD mating plane to the physical tip-face center.
tool_clocking_commissioning.dimensional_acceptance_basis: Provisional conservative FDM commissioning limits. The 0.20 mm radial runout stays below the smallest 0.25 mm single-side deep-wall clearance; 42.00 +/- 0.25 mm is the validity band for the current fixed pink-CAD TCP term. Outside either limit, repair/reprint or update and requalify the measured TCP before motion.
tool_clocking_commissioning.simulation_interpretation: Do not rotate the MuJoCo peg by -15 deg merely because the CAD peg was clocked. The existing simulated zero remains the intended peg/socket relative zero after flange-datum teaching. Re-sample and fine-tune only if measured relative yaw falls outside the trained support or runtime observations are not transformed to the training canonical frame.
tool_clocking_commissioning.historical_pose_and_release_policy: Old work poses, releases, and data remain immutable evidence for v1.4. Their hashes are intentionally not updated and they are not authorization for a v1.5 tool.

must_revalidate_after_completion: gravity compensation for each complete integrated flange-tool
terminal Fz/dwell verifier with the 0.5 mm center hole
hardware-easy-v2 socket and peg-tip capture/contact geometry
rotational free play, yaw wall-contact onset, and torque-observability thresholds
outer-boundary and global-fallback behavior if exterior-side collision is enabled
simulation_gate.yaw_retraining_decision: If each measured peg/socket relative yaw is within [-2,+2] deg and runtime data are expressed in the training canonical frame, the CAD clocking change alone does not force retraining. Otherwise re-sample M8/M10/M12 around the measured relative yaw and run a fresh fine-tune/audit.
